sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:6

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:6:1
items.html:
At the first time the MAN rose not by means of ZON, etc.; at the second time they raised other MAN, etc.: It has already been explained that there is no one who raises MAN [Mayin Nukvin] for the completion of the upper except the lower one adjacent to it. It therefore follows that AVI cannot be completed in their Gadlut except by the rising of ZON to them as MAN. However, it is known that before AVI attain their Gadlut, ZON have no existence at all, for even the discernment of the Ibur [impregnation] of ZON has not yet come out, as above; and hence there is no one to raise the MAN to AVI — namely, the AHP that are missing to them — in order to complete them in the complete ten Sefirot, as above (Inner Light, item 5, the passage beginning “AA”). And this is what the ARI says, “however, at first, at the first time, the MAN rose not by means of ZON, in AVI” — meaning, as explained, that there is no ZON yet in the world to raise the MAN to them; hence it is imperative that the MAN rise of themselves, not by means of ZON.
Yet one must understand well how it is possible for the MAN to rise of themselves, and who is the cause of their rising to AVI, for this knowledge is the axis upon which all the matters of MAN turn. And the ARI has summed up for us in several places that every lower one raises the MAN that belong to its upper to the Partzuf above the upper, namely to the third degree; and the upper of the upper corrects them for the sake of the upper. Thus, three degrees join in the raising of MAN. And this must be understood. And the matter is that after AVI were corrected at the first time by AA, namely in the discernment of their Katnut, they are already fit to rise as MAN to AA, and they return to the AVI of AA face to face, as above (page 628, the passage beginning “and afterwards”). And by the illumination of the coupling of Aba and Ima face to face, the bottom Hey descends from the discernment of the Einayim of AVI and prepares the vessels of the AHP to return to the degree of AVI; and then ZON rise in the discernment of MAN and complete the vessels of AVI. Thus, at the time of the rising of AVI as MAN to AA, they carry within them all the records of posterior that fell from all the Partzufim of Nekudim, as above (Inner Light, Part 8, item 1, the passage beginning “returned”), study it there well. And all the couplings are made principally upon the discernment of the records; and after the records are corrected, they bestow their correction upon the vessels attributed to them, as known. And therefore, after the coupling of the AVI of AA face to face was made and they lowered the bottom Hey from the Einayim of the discernments of the records to the Peh of the records included in AVI, it is regarded as though ZON themselves rose and were included in the coupling, although they themselves have not yet been emanated; for the records of the AHP included in AVI, as above, are the discernments of ZON, except that they are included in AVI in the discernments of records, as explained. And here it turns out that the records of the GE of ZON raised the AHP of the upper, which is AVI, to the upper of the upper, which is AA, for the sake of the upper, which is to complete the GAR [first three] of AVI.
And it is explained here that the principal one that rises as MAN is AVI, since they are already corrected in the discernment of their Katnut; it is also explained that all the records of the lower ones are included in AVI, and consequently also the records of ZON; and these records of ZON, which are in AVI without correction, are what cause AVI to rise as MAN to AA. And this is regarded as the MAN having risen of themselves, namely from within their inclusion in AVI.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:6:2
items.html: From those MAN the discernment of ZON was made: For those MAN [Mayin Nukvin] included in AVI — which are the records of the AHP that fell from them to ZON, as above in the adjacent item — are composed of two discernments: the first is the discernments of the Sefirot of the AHP that fell from AVI and became the discernments of ZON; and the second is the discernment of ZON themselves, into which the AHP of AVI fell. And before their correction they are one discernment and one degree, namely only the degree of ZON, for the upper that comes to the place of the lower becomes like it. However, after they rose as MAN with AVI to AA, as above, and MAD [male waters] descended upon them there, which lower the bottom Hey from the Einayim and return the AHP of AVI to their degree, then the AHP are divided into two degrees: their internality joins with AVI and completes the vessels of Bina and ZON that were missing to them, along with their lights of GAR. And their externality, which was at first the portion of ZON, will certainly not be able to join with the Sefirot of AVI, for those MAD, which suffice to lower the bottom Hey from the Einayim of AVI, do not suffice to lower the bottom Hey from the Einayim of the discernment of ZON, since the restriction that rides upon the AHP of ZON is much harsher than the restriction that rides upon the AHP of AVI. And therefore only the discernments of the anterior vessels of ZON, which are GE, can receive correction from this coupling of the Gadlut of AVI, being in their value the discernment of a Rosh [head]; but the posterior vessels, which are AHP, cannot receive any correction from there. And this is what he said, “and then, from those MAN, the discernment of ZON was made” — meaning that from those MAN that rose with AVI to the coupling of their Gadlut, the discernment of the Katnut of ZON was also corrected, namely the discernment of their anterior vessels, which are GE, from which comes out the discernment of the Ibur [impregnation] of ZON. Thus, two discernments were corrected from the MAN that rose with AVI: the first is the completion of the ten Sefirot of vessels and Mochin of AVI themselves; and the second is the discernment of the Katnut of ZON.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:6:3
items.html: At the second time they raised other MAN and other sparks up to the upper Ima: That is, as above in the adjacent item, as written concerning AVI: after ZON received their correction through the coupling of the Gadlut of AVI, by which the discernment of the Katnut of ZON was corrected, as above, then ZON too are able to rise as MAN [Mayin Nukvin] to AVI of their own accord; and it is regarded that they take with them the records of the vessels of the AHP that fell from them to the discernments of the NRN [Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama] of the righteous — in the same manner that was explained above in the risings of AVI as MAN to AA; see there. For these records are included in ZON. And it follows that at the time of the rising of ZON as MAN to AVI, they take and raise with them other MAN as well, and other sparks, namely those that belong to the NRN of the righteous.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:6:4
items.html: In the belly of the upper Ima, and the form of the newborn could not be corrected and depicted from them: The belly is the secret of the AHP of the Guf [body], namely from the Chazeh [chest] and below, that is, the AHP of Tevuna, which is the Guf of AVI. For at first the coupling is made upon the MAN [Mayin Nukvin] for the sake of ZON themselves, which is the first discernment included in the MAN that ZON raised to AVI; and therefore the MAD [male waters] suffice to complete the MAN that they raised and to return the discernments of the AHP of the discernments of ZON, for the completion of the vessels and Mochin of their own Gadlut. However, the second discernment included in the MAN — the records of the GE of the NRN [Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama] of the righteous — still cannot receive anything from these MAD, for they are not of their discernment. And this is what he said, “and the form of a newborn could not be corrected and depicted from them, for they had then just come out from within the Klipot [shells]” — that is, although in truth the MAN of the souls of the righteous are included in the AHP of ZON, which have already received their correction in the belly of the upper Ima, nevertheless, since the coupling does not pertain to them, they need a special coupling that will correct their GE in the discernment of the Ibur [impregnation], as said.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:6:5
items.html: They returned with ZON, and all of them together rose again to raise other MAN a second time: For after the coupling and the birth of the Gadlut of ZON are completed, and ZON return to their place, then the coupling is made upon those MAN [Mayin Nukvin] of the souls of the righteous that had not yet received their correction from the rising to AVI, as above. And there, in ZON — namely, in the belly of the Nukva — they are depicted and receive the coupling of their Katnut.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:6:6
items.html: And those MAN return and raise, with the joining of ZON, other MAN, and then they are depicted and corrected: Explanation: since they have now already received the coupling of their Katnut from ZON, at the second time they rise again as MAN [Mayin Nukvin] to ZON in order to receive the Mochin of Gadlut; and at this time they already rise of their own accord, as above. And now, at the rising of the MAN — which are the souls of the righteous — of their own accord, they raise other MAN and sparks, in the manner that was explained in the rising of the MAN of ZON of their own accord: they take with them the records of the AHP that are missing to them; and these records are always composed of two discernments: the first is the discernments of the AHP missing to the souls of the righteous themselves; and the second is the lower degree of the souls, into which those AHP fell, as above — study it there well. And this is what he said: those MAN return and raise, with the joining of ZON, other MAN, and then they are depicted and corrected. For at the time when they are fit to rise as MAN of their own accord — namely, at the time when they rise as MAN for the coupling of Gadlut — they necessarily take with them the records of the lower degree, where the AHP missing to them are found. However, the coupling is made only upon the first discernment of the MAN, namely only upon the discernment of the AHP that belong to the souls, and not upon the discernment of the lower degree in which the MAN are placed, as above concerning ZON — see there — except that it needs a special second coupling of its own; and then the Katnut of the lower degree comes out from the souls. And this is what the ARI precisely says, “and then they are depicted and corrected” — meaning that only the souls are depicted and corrected in the Mochin of Gadlut, but those MAN that rose with them still receive no correction whatsoever.
